content.text: Rate-and-term refinance Reduce your interest rate and term This no-cash-out mortgage refinancing option can lower your monthly payment or allow you pay off your house sooner. Cash-out refinance Access to cash as you refinance Use the equity in your home to pay for home improvements, a down payment on a second home or college tuition. Need help choosing the right refinance loan? If you’re ready to refinance your mortgage but aren’t sure about your options, it may be time to find a mortgage loan officer. A mortgage loan officer can offer you guidance on choosing the right refinance loan for your specific needs. Start your application if you’re ready to refinance your mortgage. Get answers to frequently asked questions about refinance rates. Interest rates on a cash-out refinance may be slightly higher than they are for a rate-and-term refinance. This is because when you withdraw cash from the equity in your home, the new mortgage amount will be higher than your existing loan making it more of a risk to the lender.
